profile.headline: Tech Lead at Applied Intuition
profile.summary: I am a Principal Engineer at Motional. I am working on ML planner to utilize recent advances in ML for autonomous vehicle trajectory planning. My interest is applying ML in robot planning such as imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and vision language action model. Prior to working at Motional, I received PhD from MIT Mechanical Engineering.

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
Working on next generation ML planner applying imitation learning and reinforcement learning for autonomous vehicle trajectory planning
- Leading cross functional effort on various ML planner projects including data mining, synthetic data generation, sim to on-road gap improvement, and new deployment architecture design
- Led ML planner discussion in Director and above KPI discussions and demos between Motional and Hyundai Motors Group, parent company of Motional
- Mentoring and participating in high impact research topics such as applying LLM to ML planner data mining, MCTS trajectory generation, and self-play reinforcement learning for autonomous driving

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
ML planner team working on putting next generation planner in production
- Tech lead in ML planning team, leading a sub team of 6 engineers
- Design, develop, and productionize a transformer based IRL trajectory ranker from scratch. This involves setting up ML planner data mining, training, and evaluation pipeline from scratch. This imitation learning planner learned driving from human expert driving data to demonstrate comfortable and human like driving.
- Led four ML planner releases with key features such as traffic light handling, expanding geofence and ODD, creeping reduction, and cut in improvement
- Demoed ML planner to 15+ senior leadership in the end of the year demo. This showed a human like driving comfort and pivoted company direction toward ML planner from MPC based classical planner.
Research scientist in Autonomy Research team
- Research on various ML planning methods such as closed loop imitation learning, inverse reinforcement learning, and Monte Carlo tree search
